titleStmt.title: Empirical Study of Student Agency in Collaborative Inquiry

abstract.p: This paper presents a longitudinal study examining how adaptive scaffolding impacts learner agency and self-regulation in collaborative science environments.

div.head: 1. Methodology and Context
div.p: A mixed-methods quasi-experimental design was deployed across 14 high school classrooms over 12 weeks.

div.head: 2. Observations and Findings
div.p: Students exhibiting higher agency scores demonstrated more frequent metacognitive regulation episodes.
